newsitem.title: USA: Fabri-Centers sets FY 1998 store plans.
newsitem.headline: Fabri-Centers sets FY 1998 store plans.

text.p: Fabri-Centers of American Inc said Tuesday it expects to open 65 to 70 stores and close 75 to 80 smaller stores in fiscal 1998.
Fabri-Centers said it opened 11 larger stores and closed 12 smaller or under-performing stores in the first quarter of fiscal 1998.
Fabri-Centers said plans include opening six "Jo-Ann etc" stores, the company's 45,000 square foot megastore format.
The company said it currently operates 913 stores in 48 states, primarily under the names of Jo-Ann Fabrics and Crafts, Cloth World, New York Fabrics and Jo-Ann etc.
